preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The size of the array A and the parameter K are between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element of the array A is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if the array can be made palindromic or 'NO' if it cannot.
